name: Earth Sapta
summary: At Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather prepares another Earth Sapta when a young shaman loses the brew before completing the rite. The draught opens a novice’s sight to the spirits of stone and lets the trial continue.

sections.title: A Visionary Draught
sections.body: Young shaman begin by learning to sense forces beyond ordinary sight. To meet Mulgore’s earth elementals, an initiate drinks a sapta, a ritual brew made with natural essences of stone and soil. The Earth Sapta lifts the veil between the physical and spiritual realms, letting a novice see and commune with the spirits of the land.

sections.title: A Second Chance at Sight
sections.body: A novice may lose or spill the brew before reaching the stone monument for communion. Seer Ravenfeather waits at Camp Narache and prepares another vessel when a pupil needs one. With the draught restored, the novice can continue the rite and face the spirits.

faq.answer: An Earth Sapta is a herbal preparation brewed by shamanic elders. When an initiate drinks it, the draught awakens inner senses and grants the spiritual sight needed to perceive and commune with earth elementals hidden from ordinary eyes.

faq.q: Why would an initiate need another Earth Sapta?
faq.answer: An initiate may lose or spill the draught in the wilds before reaching the sacred site. Seer Ravenfeather provides another dose so a mistake does not halt the training.
Seer Ravenfeather is a tauren spiritual guide at Camp Narache in Mulgore. She guides young tauren shaman through their earliest trials and first communion with the spirits of the earth.

faq.q: Why must shaman drink a sapta to see elementals?
aliases: why need a potion to see spirits
faq.answer: Novice shaman have not yet learned to perceive the elements at will. A sapta bridges their senses until they learn to listen to and commune with the elements through their own power.

faq.q: Where does the trial of the Earth Sapta take place?
faq.answer: The trial takes place in the hills of Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore, near Camp Narache. Novices carry the draught to a sacred stone monument where local earth spirits dwell.
Tauren and orcish shamanic traditions both use saptas for initial elemental initiations. Earth, fire, and water each have their own sapta to attune a shaman’s senses to that elemental plane.

angles.text: As a shaman, you begin with a sapta that opens your sight to the elemental forces guiding the world.
As a tauren, you begin honoring the Earth Mother by learning to hear the land. The elders of Camp Narache make sure no youth is turned away from this sacred path.
As a member of the Horde, you see shamanic traditions nurtured in Mulgore, where tribal seers guide the next generation of spiritual leaders.
